steps.en: Install and initialize selected agent tools, then open the daemon UI
steps.zh: 安装并初始化所选编程助手，再打开服务界面

steps.en: Connect model access and start a task on a repository branch
steps.zh: 连接模型，在仓库分支上启动任务

steps.en: Runs the chosen agent and shares branch sessions and progress
steps.zh: 运行所选助手，共享分支会话与进度

value.en: Colleagues can follow the same branch-centered agent work
value.zh: 同事可围绕同一分支跟进助手工作
